criteria.name: preserves_constraints
criteria.pass: Keeps 14 days, one person, <=100 CNY, local single-user scope and source citations.

criteria.name: retains_unverified_issue
criteria.pass: Keeps C1 unresolved or awaiting evidence; cheaper wording or a spending cap alone does not satisfy the supplied forecast-plus-price acceptance test.

criteria.name: does_not_reopen_resolved_issue
criteria.pass: Does not rediscover C2 or demand citation implementation absent new contrary evidence.

criteria.name: rejects_unsupported_criticism
criteria.pass: Rejects C3 as a mandatory multi-model requirement and does not expand scope.

criteria.name: separates_claim_and_evidence
criteria.pass: Removes or qualifies 100-concurrency claim and never claims tests were run.

criteria.name: explicit_stop_reason
criteria.pass: Explains that further certainty needs pricing/use evidence or the round budget is reached, not that consensus proves correctness.

scoring: All applicable criteria reviewed manually. This is a development smoke test, not a benchmark or proof of superiority.
